tools.name: customers_create

params.name: input-accepted-service-agreement

params.name: input-assignee-id
params.description: Member id assigned to manage this customer.

params.name: input-metadata

params.description: Date and time when the customer opted out of WhatsApp reminders.

params.name: input-secondary-phone-number

params.name: input-tags

params.name: input-data-reply-with-assistant

params.name: input-data-tos-ip

params.name: input-otp

tools.name: discounts_create
tools.description: Creates a new reusable discount. Required: input. Returns the new CreateDiscountPayload.

params.name: input-amount-off
params.description: Fixed discount amount in minor currency units. Required when type is FIXED.

params.name: input-codes
params.description: Redeemable codes that grant this discount. Codes are uppercased automatically.

params.name: input-max-applications
params.description: Maximum number of times this discount can be applied.

params.name: input-percentage-off
params.description: Percentage to discount (0-100). Required when type is PERCENTAGE.

params.name: input-type
params.description: Whether the discount is a fixed amount (FIXED) or a percentage (PERCENTAGE).

tools.name: discounts_delete
tools.description: Deletes a discount and all associated discount codes. Required: id. Returns the DeleteDiscountPayload. Destructive.

tools.name: discounts_get-by-id
tools.description: Returns a single discount by id. Required: id.

tools.name: discounts_list
tools.description: Returns reusable discounts for the organization. One-off discounts are excluded. Optional: filter, skip (default: 0), take (default: 20) (plus 1 more).

tools.name: discounts_update
tools.description: Updates editable fields of an existing discount by id. Required: id. Optional: active, amountOff, codes (plus 7 more). Returns the updated UpdateDiscountPayload.

params.name: amountOff
params.description: Fixed discount amount in minor currency units. Required when type is FIXED.

params.name: codes
params.description: Replaces all existing codes with this list. Codes are uppercased automatically.

params.name: maxApplications
params.description: Maximum number of times this discount can be applied.

params.name: percentageOff
params.description: Percentage to discount (0-100). Required when type is PERCENTAGE.

params.name: type
params.description: Whether the discount is a fixed amount (FIXED) or a percentage (PERCENTAGE).

tools.name: invoices_cancel
tools.description: Cancels an unpaid invoice by id. Required: id. Returns the CancelInvoicePayload. Destructive.

tools.name: invoices_create
tools.description: Creates a new invoice for a customer. Required: input. Returns the new CreateInvoicePayload.

params.name: input-allow-offtime-payment
params.description: Whether the customer can pay before the due date.

params.name: input-beneficiary-id
params.description: Optional identifier of a different customer who is the actual beneficiary of the invoice.

params.name: input-collection-method
params.description: How payment is collected: SEND_REMINDER sends a notification, AUTOMATIC charges a saved payment method, NONE does nothing.

params.name: input-customer-id
params.description: Identifier of the customer being invoiced.

params.name: input-discounts
params.description: Discounts to apply to this invoice.

params.name: input-due-date
params.description: Date when the invoice is due for payment.

params.name: input-expire-date
params.description: Optional date after which the invoice can no longer be paid. Must be after dueDate.

params.name: input-items
params.description: Line items for the invoice. Each must reference an existing concept or provide an inline concept.

params.name: input-metadata
params.description: Custom key-value metadata to attach to the invoice.

params.name: input-modifiers
params.description: Price modifiers (early payment discounts or late payment interest) to apply to this invoice.

params.name: input-subscription-id
params.description: Optional subscription this invoice belongs to.

params.name: input-existing-payment-settled-amount

tools.name: payment-concepts_create
tools.description: Creates a new product or service in the catalog. Required: input. Returns the new CreatePaymentConceptPayload.

params.name: input-active
params.description: Whether this concept is immediately available for use.

params.name: input-amount
params.description: Unit price in minor currency units (e.g. cents).

params.name: input-amount-editable
params.description: Whether customers can customize the price.

params.name: input-charge-each
params.description: Number of intervals between charges (deprecated: use recurrentDetail instead).

params.name: input-collection-interval
params.description: Time interval unit for recurring charges (deprecated: use recurrentDetail instead).

params.name: input-currency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the organization currency.

params.name: input-description
params.description: Optional longer description of the product or service.

params.name: input-display-name
params.description: Display name of the concept shown to customers.

params.name: input-group-id
params.description: Optional identifier of the group to assign this concept to.

params.name: input-metadata
params.description: Optional key-value metadata entries to attach to the concept.

params.name: input-one-off
params.description: Whether this concept is a one-time custom charge.

params.name: input-quantity-editable
params.description: Whether customers can customize the quantity.

params.name: input-recurrent-detail-collection-interval
params.description: Time interval unit for recurring charges.

params.name: input-recurrent-detail-tolerance-days
params.description: Grace days after the due date before the invoice expires.

params.name: input-sku
params.description: Optional unique SKU for internal identification.

params.name: input-tax-info-tax-rate
params.description: Tax rate as a decimal between 0 and 1.

params.name: input-tolerance-days
params.description: Grace days after due date (deprecated: use recurrentDetail instead).

params.name: input-amount
params.description: Total amount in minor currency units (used when items are not provided).

params.name: input-cancel-url
params.description: URL to redirect to if the payer cancels.

params.name: input-currency
params.description: ISO 4217 currency code (used when items are not provided).

params.name: input-customer-external-id
params.description: External ID used to match or create the customer.

params.name: input-customer-force-update
params.description: Whether to treat the provided customer contact fields as authoritative. If another customer in the organization has the provided email or phone number, that field is unset from the other customer and set on the resolved customer.

params.name: input-customer-metadata
params.description: Metadata entries to attach to the customer.

params.name: input-customer-phone-number
params.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format.

params.name: input-description
params.description: Payment description (used when items are not provided).

params.name: input-display-mode
params.description: How the payment UI is presented.

params.name: input-expires-at
params.description: Optional expiration time for the session.

params.name: input-items
params.description: Line items to include in the session. Overrides amount/currency/description if provided.

params.name: input-metadata
params.description: Metadata entries to attach to the session.

params.name: input-return-url
params.description: URL to redirect to after successful payment.

tools.name: subscriptions_cancel
tools.description: Cancels an active subscription by id. Required: id, input. Returns the CancelSubscriptionPayload. Destructive.

tools.name: subscriptions_create
tools.description: Creates a new recurring subscription for a customer. Required: input. Returns the new CreateSubscriptionPayload.

params.name: input-beneficiary-id
params.description: Optional identifier of a different customer who is the actual beneficiary.

params.name: input-collection-method
params.description: How payment is collected: SEND_REMINDER sends a notification, AUTOMATIC charges a saved payment method, NONE does nothing.

params.name: input-customer-id
params.description: Identifier of the customer who will be charged.

params.name: input-description
params.description: Human-readable description of the subscription. Auto-generated from item names when omitted.

params.name: input-discounts
params.description: Discounts to apply to generated invoices.

params.name: input-invoices
params.description: Pre-defined invoices with explicit due dates and items. Mutually exclusive with `items`.

params.name: input-items
params.description: Recurring items whose invoices are auto-generated on each collection date. Mutually exclusive with `invoices`.

params.name: input-modifiers
params.description: Price modifiers (early payment discounts or late payment interest) to apply to every generated invoice.

params.name: input-next-collection-date
params.description: Date of the first (or next) charge. Required when using recurring `items`.

params.name: input-number-of-payments
params.description: Total number of invoices to generate before the subscription ends. Null means indefinite.

params.name: input-only-automatic-collection
params.description: Whether this subscription only allows automatic payment collection.

params.name: input-payment-method-id
params.description: Identifier of the payment method to use for automatic collection. Falls back to the customer's default method.

params.name: input-recurrent-detail-tolerance-days
params.description: Grace days after the due date before the invoice expires.

params.name: input-tax-profile-id
params.description: Optional tax profile to use for invoice generation.

params.name: input-template-id
params.description: Optional template to use for subscription messaging.
